scope: Additional exact historic Lisp source labels from seven existing main dossiers, absent from ratified D1-D9, canonical D10 v5 and two existing candidate queues. Labels are not independently proven semantics.
policy: Research intake only; do not count these 80 labels as D10 residents.
Require individual law, positive and falsifying examples, semantic dedup and independent oracle prior to selection.
No new Git branches, no change to physical T5, D1-D9, or D10 selected code map.

The selected D10 inventory already contains MAPATOMS with the same MacLisp p. 2-95 law: apply a function to every symbol in a selected/current intern table without exposing its bucket representation. traces.reference: MacLisp Reference Manual, 17 Dec 1975, §5.4 pp. 2-53–2-54 (interning/multiple obarrays) and §9 mapping functions p. 2-95 (MAPATOMS); https://softwarepreservation.computerhistory.org/LISP/MIT/MACLISP_Reference_Manual-Dec_17_1975.pdf
